paper_title: No evidence for axions from Chandra observation of magnetic white dwarf
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (the C_aee = C_agamma solid red boundary)
notes: The primary measured limit is on the coupling combination g_agamma*g_aee < 1.3e-25 GeV^-1 for m_a < 5e-6 eV (from Fig. 1/4). Translating requires an assumption relating C_aee and C_agamma. Two benchmarks are given: (i) C_aee=C_agamma gives g_agamma < 5.5e-13 GeV^-1; (ii) loop-induced W-phobic (C_aee=1.6e-4 C_agamma) gives g_agamma < 4.4e-11 GeV^-1. I report the conservative robust W-phobic bound as a flat mass-independent line over the validity range m_a in [1e-11, 5e-6] eV. For C_aee=C_agamma scenario the bound would be [[1e-11,5.5e-13],[5e-6,5.5e-13]].
